complicacoes.texto: Bombshell looks down on just about everyone and only grudgingly offers her respect, making her difficult to get along with and Não Confiável when it comes to team tactics. This causes constant friction with the other Teen Titans.

Extreme Calor followed by extreme Frio attacks can Enfraquecer her Dilustel shell, making it easy to crack if damaged. Under such conditions, temporarily remove her Resistência Impenetrável and Proteção Powers. Any attacks resulting in two degrees of failure on her Dano resistance check mean the shell is cracked, whereas three degrees of failure shatters the shell temporarily.

Bombshell’s Dilustel shell is not Permanente, and so she loses its benefits and her access to the Quantum Field if the Dilustel is not activated or is somehow negated or dispersed. The shell Vontade also disappear for a time if shattered (see her “Crack the Shell” complication). She has Str 1 and Sta 2 without the shell.
